title: Corn Alien in Fleur-de-Lis
description: A purple-skinned alien with large glowing green eyes wears an ornate golden astronaut helmet and suit made of corn cobs and kernels. The alien stands in a swirling dark pool of liquid with one hand touching its helmet, set against a cracked glass-like background with a dramatic sunset sky and corn stalks.
prompt: A purple alien with large luminous green eyes and intricate white facial markings stands in a swirling dark pool of liquid. It wears a golden astronaut helmet decorated with corn cobs and a purple fleur-de-lis crest on top, along with a matching golden suit covered in corn kernels and blue patterns. One hand is raised to its helmet. The background shows cracked glass texture, purple and green aurora-like glows, scattered fleur-de-lis symbols, and corn stalks under a dramatic sunset sky.
